req.title: Create new player
req.statement: The system shall create a player and respond with HTTP 201 when POST /players/ receives a valid Player payload.
expected_outcomes: Location header points to new resource

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates HTTP 201 on POST /players/ with a valid payload, a Location header pointing to the new resource, and appropriate 4xx/5xx on error paths. Tests cover: (1) EP positive — valid full payload yields 201 + correct Location + correct response body fields; (2) NEG — duplicate squad_number yields 409 Conflict; (3) NEG — missing required field yields 422 Unprocessable Entity; (4) BVA — squad_number boundary at 0 (invalid domain edge) vs 1 (lowest pre-loaded); (5) DT — optional fields absent yields 201 with null values; (6) STC — create then verify resource exists at Location. All assertions use exact values to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_post_player_valid_full_payload_returns_201_with_location
preconditions: Squad number 99 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with a complete valid PlayerRequestModel payload using squad_number=99
expected: Response body contains id (UUID), first_name='Tester', last_name='User', squad_number=99, position='Goalkeeper'
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_post_player_valid_full_payload_returns_201_with_location():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Tester",
        "middleName": "Mid",
        "lastName": "User",
        "dateOfBirth": "1990-06-15T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper",
        "abbrPosition": "GK",
        "team": "Test FC",
        "league": "Test League",
        "starting11": True
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    assert r.headers["location"] == "/players/squadnumber/99"
    body = r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Tester"
    assert body["middleName"] == "Mid"
    assert body["lastName"] == "User"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"
    assert body["abbrPosition"] == "GK"
    assert body["team"] == "Test FC"
    assert body["league"] == "Test League"
    assert body["starting11"] is True
    assert "id" in body
    assert len(body["id"]) == 36

test_post_player_valid_full_payload_returns_201_with_location()

tests.name: test_post_player_then_get_by_location_returns_same_data
actions: GET the URL from the Location header
expected: GET on Location URL returns HTTP 200
GET response body matches the created player data exactly
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_post_player_then_get_by_location_returns_same_data():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "State",
        "middleName": "Trans",
        "lastName": "Test",
        "dateOfBirth": "1985-03-20T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 75,
        "position": "Central Midfield",
        "abbrPosition": "CM",
        "team": "State FC",
        "league": "State League",
        "starting11": False
    }
    post_r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert post_r.status_code == 201
    location = post_r.headers["location"]
    assert location == "/players/squadnumber/75"
    get_r = client.get(location)
    assert get_r.status_code == 200
    body = get_r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "State"
    assert body["middleName"] == "Trans"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Test"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 75
    assert body["position"] == "Central Midfield"
    assert body["starting11"] is False

test_post_player_then_get_by_location_returns_same_data()

tests.name: test_post_player_empty_body_returns_422
actions: POST /players/ with an empty JSON body {}
expected: Validation errors listed for missing required fields
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_post_player_empty_body_returns_422():
    r = client.post("/players/", json={})
    assert r.status_code == 422
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    assert isinstance(body["detail"], list)
    fields_with_errors = [e["loc"][-1] for e in body["detail"] if "loc" in e]
    assert "firstName" in fields_with_errors or "first_name" in fields_with_errors
    assert "lastName" in fields_with_errors or "last_name" in fields_with_errors

test_post_player_empty_body_returns_422()
